fusions.name: Headlong Butt
fusions.desc: A charging blow with your whole mass that deals 15 damage, knocks the target 3 tiles back and leaves it 12% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Crag Gore
fusions.desc: A goring strike that deals 7 damage and makes the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds. It holds 3 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Ledge-Set Footing
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 20% for 12 seconds. Your movement speed rises 10% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Holds the Ledge
fusions.desc: When your health falls below 40%, you regain 4 health a second for 5 seconds. Once every 20 seconds.
